The exact published package metadata declares the license as MIT, names
Andrew Dillon as the author, and lists Devon Govett as a contributor.
Metadata verified on 13 November 2026 using:
npm view @pdf-lib/fontkit@1.1.1 name version license author contributors repository --json

Package source repository: https://github.com/Hopding/fontkit
Its README identifies this project as a fork of https://github.com/foliojs/fontkit
and also declares MIT licensing.

The published fork does not include a standalone LICENSE file. The original
upstream Fontkit MIT license is reproduced verbatim below, with its original
copyright notice. The fork attribution above comes from the published package
metadata; it does not invent a separate copyright notice for the fork.
